newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan first quarter GDP seen rising 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan first quarter GDP seen rising 6.6 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's first-quarter gross domestic product likely will rise around 6.6 percent, up from a February forecast of 6.4 percent, the cabinet's Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said on Monday.

"Exports, imports and industrial output performance all had improved in the first quarter, so we estimate the actual GDP growth likely would be higher than originally expected," an official at the directorate told Reuters.
GDP growth for the full year 1997 may be raised to 6.3 percent from a February forecast of 6.28 percent, he said.
